text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond has accomplished incredible things during her first three years in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond! Have you decided on your next race? There have been many rumors about you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Will you be competing in the same race as Kitasan Black? Or perhaps something else?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My next step is to move to the international stage.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I plan to compete in races steeped in tradition and prestige, and carve out a new chapter in history for the Umamusume of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you'll be heading to France?! Please tell us about your plans in detail!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond's announcement of her intention to enter international races creates a stir of excitement throughout Japan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her absolute confidence in victory and composed demeanor has undoubtedly convinced many people of her potential to reshape history.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Most encouraging! I'm expecting great things from you and await reports of your success!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you, ma'am! As a representative of Umamusume across Japan, I'll run with pride and dignity!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I promise to accomplish the cherished goal that Japanese Umamusume have dreamed of for so long!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Your travel arrangements are complete. I'll email you the details, so make sure you both check them carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Take care and have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's almost time for us to depart, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hm? Why do you look so conflicted? Aren't you happy?
choice_data_list: I was just thinking about how quickly time flies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond decided to embark on her expedition to France immediately after completing her first three years of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following that, preparation for her the international debut progressed smoothly. I can't believe that we're already leaving tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I was the one who decided to continue taking on new challenges, so I can't afford to let up even a little.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll aim for the top wherever I go, and carve a new chapter in history for both the Satono family and the Umamusume of Japan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The more challenging the goal, the more worthwhile it is to accomplish, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond speaks with great enthusiasm. The moment she fulfills one dream, her unwavering passion pushes her on to the next.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are, Dia!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're leaving tomorrow, right? I won't see you for a while, so I thought I'd come and wish you safe travels!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't forget to get me an awesome souvenir!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to get you the very best souvenir ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio, what manner of goodbye is that?! And don't just agree with her, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Well, it's not like we're never seeing each other again. In fact, I'm really looking forward to racing against Dia when she gets back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-well, I suppose I'm of the same mind…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'd be honored to run against you. I hope we get the chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I hope the history you'll write for the Satono family will be a glorious one. As a member of the Mejiro family, I eagerly look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Have a safe trip.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Thank you both!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day, on the day of our departure…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mother! Father! Sorry for keeping you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness! You're finally here! What took you so long? You had me worried.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not exactly… I was having trouble fitting everything into my suitcase.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: What? Did you only start packing this morning?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haha… Well, what happened was…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Shouldn't you be leaving around now?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's right. I'm off, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Erm… Where's your luggage?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I gave my bags to Tazuna yesterday. She said she'd send them to the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: No, no! I mean the stuff you're taking with you today! Don't you need a change of clothes and toiletries?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Like I said, they've already been sent to the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hold on. You know it takes longer than a day for your stuff to get to France, right?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It does?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But our bags are always waiting for us at the hotel when I travel with my family.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: That's probably because your family staff brought it all as carry-on luggage or sent it in advance, and you just never knew!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I can't take it anymore! Come on! I'll help you pack!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Oh dear, where did I put my large suitcase again?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, I'll ask your trainer to handle the check-in process ahead of time and make sure you can board with carry-on luggage!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened. I was worried about Dia doing everything on her own, so I also came to see her off.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I made it in time thanks to Kita and Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: Kita, I'm sorry for all nonsense Dia puts you through… Thank you for always being there for her.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's no problem! They don't call me the clutch captain for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But I won't be able to help her after today… Ah, I'm getting really nervous all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're such a worrywart, Kita! I'll be fine on my own!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Make sure you take good care of her!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for any trouble Dia causes. She still has a lot to learn about the world…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Not you too, Father! I said I'll be fine…

text_block_list.name: Dia's Mother
text_block_list.text: You're not worried about a thing, are you? It must be because you have someone as reliable as your trainer by your side.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Yes, precisely. Trainer has never led me astray!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm not worried at all about the path ahead of me either!

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Dia is the Satono family's most precious gem, Trainer. Please continue to guide and support her.

text_block_list.name: Dia's Father
text_block_list.text: Dia, we'll be cheering for you as you take on the challenges you've chosen for yourself! Do your very best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Father, Mother… Thank you. I'll make history as an illustrious runner of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You can expect great things from me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Satono Diamond leaves for a foreign land, seeking to take on the challenges that lie ahead and forge a new chapter of history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The path she's embarking on will surely be one that gleams in the annals of history with the dazzling sheen of a diamond.
